title: Kirkwood-Dirac distributions in classical optics
summary: We develop a comprehensive analysis of the Kirkwood-Dirac distributions in classical optics, revealing their deep connection with optical coherence as fundamental concept in optics. From their very definition, the Kirkwood-Dirac distributions emerge as generalized mutual coherence functions involving two different bases instead of just one. This perspective provides a unified interpretation of the so-called anomalous values, that are complex and negative values, as direct manifestations of coherence. We show that this interpretation consistently applies across all field variables considered…
